title: 再生混凝土骨材品管~Quality control of recycled concrete aggregate
focus: 再生骨材吸水、級配、污染與混凝土試拌驗證~Recycled-aggregate absorption, gradation, contamination and trial-mix validation
summary: 以「再生骨材吸水、級配、污染與混凝土試拌驗證」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow recycled-aggregate absorption, gradation, contamination and trial-mix validation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 母材來源與殘留砂漿~Parent material and adhered mortar
units.mechanism: 再生骨材由原骨材與附著砂漿組成，母材來源與損傷影響吸水及耐久性；不可只看顆粒外觀。~Recycled aggregate combines original aggregate and adhered mortar; source and damage affect absorption and durability, beyond appearance.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：mortar fraction=attached mortar/total;180/1000；計算 180/1000 = 0.18 fraction。適用限制：假想材料表徵，不以此單一值判定合格。~Original hypothetical teaching example: mortar fraction=attached mortar/total;180/1000; calculation 180/1000 = 0.18 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical characterization; no acceptance from this value alone.
units.verify: 分別記錄來源路段、母材病害與砂漿比例。~Record source section, parent distress and adhered-mortar fraction separately.
units.failure: 混合未知來源使後續異常無法追溯。~Mixing unknown sources prevents tracing later anomalies.
units.misconception: 所有破碎混凝土都能視為相同品質的骨材。~All crushed concrete is equivalent aggregate.
units.practice: 在「母材來源與殘留砂漿」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.18 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「混合未知來源使後續異常無法追溯。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for parent material and adhered mortar, first reproduce 0.18 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing unknown sources prevents tracing later anomalies." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 級配與累積通過率~Gradation and cumulative passing
units.mechanism: 級配決定顆粒堆積與漿體需求；必須用整條篩分曲線而非單一最大粒徑。~Gradation affects packing and paste demand; use a full sieve curve rather than maximum size alone.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：passing=(total-retained cumulative)/total; (1000-350)/1000；計算 (1000-350)/1000 = 0.65 fraction。適用限制：假想單一篩孔點，完整評估需其他篩孔。~Original hypothetical teaching example: passing=(total-retained cumulative)/total; (1000-350)/1000; calculation (1000-350)/1000 = 0.65 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical single sieve point; full evaluation requires others.
units.verify: 將一段粒級不足的樣本與連續級配比較空隙量。~Compare voids in a gap-graded sample and continuous gradation.
units.failure: 相同最大粒徑也可能具有不同漿體需求。~Equal maximum size can still produce different paste demands.
units.misconception: 最大粒徑相同就代表配比可完全不變。~Equal maximum size means the mixture needs no adjustment.
units.practice: 在「級配與累積通過率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.65 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「相同最大粒徑也可能具有不同漿體需求。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for gradation and cumulative passing, first reproduce 0.65 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Equal maximum size can still produce different paste demands." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 烘乾與飽和面乾吸水率~Oven-dry and SSD absorption
units.mechanism: 吸水率以飽和面乾與烘乾質量差除烘乾質量；表面水未擦除會使吸水值偏高。~Absorption uses SSD minus oven-dry mass over oven-dry mass; unremoved surface water biases it high.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：absorption=(Mssd-Mod)/Mod;(1060-1000)/1000；計算 (1060-1000)/1000 = 0.06 fraction。適用限制：同一樣本與明示試驗程序，假想數據。~Original hypothetical teaching example: absorption=(Mssd-Mod)/Mod;(1060-1000)/1000; calculation (1060-1000)/1000 = 0.06 fraction. Applicability: Same sample under a specified test method; hypothetical data.
units.verify: 比較正確面乾與表面仍有水膜的稱量結果。~Compare correct SSD weighing with a remaining surface-water film.
units.failure: 面乾判定不一致會污染配比水修正。~Inconsistent SSD determination corrupts batch-water correction.
units.misconception: 6%吸水率是以飽和面乾質量作分母。~6% absorption uses SSD mass as its denominator.
units.practice: 在「烘乾與飽和面乾吸水率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.06 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「面乾判定不一致會污染配比水修正。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for oven-dry and ssd absorption, first reproduce 0.06 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Inconsistent SSD determination corrupts batch-water correction." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 實際含水率與自由水~Actual moisture and free water
units.mechanism: 實際含水率高於吸水率時帶入自由水；低於吸水率時可能吸收拌合水，速率還受時間影響。~Moisture above absorption adds free water; below absorption can absorb mixing water, with time-dependent kinetics.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：free water=Mod*(moisture-absorption);1000*(0.08-0.06)；計算 1000*(0.08-0.06) = 20 kg。適用限制：以烘乾質量為基準，假設達到所用吸水平衡。~Original hypothetical teaching example: free water=Mod*(moisture-absorption);1000*(0.08-0.06); calculation 1000*(0.08-0.06) = 20 kg. Applicability: Oven-dry basis assuming the stated absorption equilibrium.
units.verify: 將實際含水率改成4%，解釋負自由水的意義。~Change actual moisture to4% and explain negative free water.
units.failure: 把總含水都當自由水會少加必要拌合水。~Treating total moisture as free water under-adds mixing water.
units.misconception: 骨材含水率8%表示全部8%都可供水泥使用。~8% aggregate moisture means all8% is available to cement.
units.practice: 在「實際含水率與自由水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總含水都當自由水會少加必要拌合水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for actual moisture and free water, first reproduce 20 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating total moisture as free water under-adds mixing water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 體積置換與密度差~Volume replacement and density difference
units.mechanism: 再生與天然骨材密度不同時，等質量替換會改變絕對體積與產量；應說明置換基準。~When recycled and natural aggregate densities differ, equal-mass replacement changes absolute volume and yield; state the replacement basis.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：mass for volume=rho*V;2300*0.4；計算 2300*0.4 = 920 kg。適用限制：假想顆粒體積0.4m3與密度2300kg/m3。~Original hypothetical teaching example: mass for volume=rho*V;2300*0.4; calculation 2300*0.4 = 920 kg. Applicability: Hypothetical0.4m3 particle volume and2300kg/m3 density.
units.verify: 比較以質量與體積各置換同一比例的產量。~Compare yield for equal replacement percentages by mass and volume.
units.failure: 未說明質量或體積比例會讓兩組試拌不可比較。~Unstated mass/volume replacement makes trial mixes incomparable.
units.misconception: 置換30%永遠只有一種明確定義。~30% replacement has only one possible definition.
units.practice: 在「體積置換與密度差」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 920 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未說明質量或體積比例會讓兩組試拌不可比較。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for volume replacement and density difference, first reproduce 920 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unstated mass/volume replacement makes trial mixes incomparable." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 污染物與用途限制~Contaminants and use restrictions
units.mechanism: 木材、石膏、瀝青、氯化物等需依用途分析；總雜質量相同不代表影響相同。~Analyze wood, gypsum, asphalt, chlorides and other contaminants for the intended use; equal total contamination does not mean equal effects.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：contaminant fraction=2.5/1000；計算 2.5/1000 = 0.0025 fraction。適用限制：假想質量試驗；非通用允收上限。~Original hypothetical teaching example: contaminant fraction=2.5/1000; calculation 2.5/1000 = 0.0025 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical mass test; not a universal acceptance limit.
units.verify: 把相同總量分成不同污染種類，列出所需追加試驗。~Split equal total contamination into different types and list additional tests needed.
units.failure: 只報總雜質會掩蓋少量但重要的特定污染。~Total impurity alone hides small but important specific contaminants.
units.misconception: 總雜質低就能省略所有化學檢驗。~Low total impurity eliminates all chemical testing.
units.practice: 在「污染物與用途限制」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0025 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報總雜質會掩蓋少量但重要的特定污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for contaminants and use restrictions, first reproduce 0.0025 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total impurity alone hides small but important specific contaminants." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 有效水膠比修正~Effective water-to-binder correction
units.mechanism: 有效水量含外加水與自由水並扣除適用時間內的吸水；比值需與工作性、強度一起驗證。~Effective water includes added/free water minus absorption within the relevant time; validate the ratio with workability and strength.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：effective w/b=(added+free)/binder;(160+20)/400；計算 (160+20)/400 = 0.45 ratio。適用限制：已另滿足骨材吸水且無其他水來源。~Original hypothetical teaching example: effective w/b=(added+free)/binder;(160+20)/400; calculation (160+20)/400 = 0.45 ratio. Applicability: Aggregate absorption already satisfied; no other water sources.
units.verify: 改變自由水但保持目標水膠比，重算需加水量。~Change free water at fixed target ratio and recalculate added water.
units.failure: 現場追求坍度隨意加水會改變有效水膠比。~Adding water solely to chase slump changes effective ratio.
units.misconception: 骨材吸水率提高時只要無限加水即可保持所有性能。~Unlimited extra water preserves every property when aggregate absorption rises.
units.practice: 在「有效水膠比修正」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.45 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「現場追求坍度隨意加水會改變有效水膠比。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for effective water-to-binder correction, first reproduce 0.45 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adding water solely to chase slump changes effective ratio." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 試拌強度的平均與變異~Trial-mix strength mean and variability
units.mechanism: 試體強度須用一致製作、養護與試驗程序，平均值與離散程度共同評估。~Use consistent casting, curing and testing; assess both mean strength and variability.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：mean=(32+35+38)/3；計算 (32+35+38)/3 = 35 MPa。適用限制：假想同齡期三試體，非結構設計或驗收強度。~Original hypothetical teaching example: mean=(32+35+38)/3; calculation (32+35+38)/3 = 35 MPa. Applicability: Hypothetical same-age specimens; not design or acceptance strength.
units.verify: 新增一個偏低試體後檢查平均、離散與製作紀錄。~Add a low result and inspect mean, spread and specimen records.
units.failure: 只報最高值會掩蓋品質不穩。~Reporting only the maximum hides unstable quality.
units.misconception: 一顆試體達到目標就證明整批都達標。~One target-strength specimen proves the whole lot passes.
units.practice: 在「試拌強度的平均與變異」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 35 MPa，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報最高值會掩蓋品質不穩。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for trial-mix strength mean and variability, first reproduce 35 MPa, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting only the maximum hides unstable quality." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 收縮、耐久性與時間尺度~Shrinkage, durability and time scale
units.mechanism: 附著砂漿可能改變收縮與輸送性，短期強度不足以代表長期耐久；試驗要符合預定暴露。~Adhered mortar can alter shrinkage and transport; short-term strength does not represent long-term durability, so tests must match exposure.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：strain=length change/original;0.3/500；計算 0.3/500 = 0.0006 strain。適用限制：假想長度變化0.3mm、標距500mm；溫度效應另計。~Original hypothetical teaching example: strain=length change/original;0.3/500; calculation 0.3/500 = 0.0006 strain. Applicability: Hypothetical0.3mm change over500mm; thermal effects separate.
units.verify: 比較相同養護下天然與再生骨材試體的時間曲線。~Compare time curves for natural and recycled aggregate under equal curing.
units.failure: 未控制溫濕度會把環境差異誤當材料效應。~Uncontrolled temperature/humidity confounds material effects.
units.misconception: 28天強度相同就代表所有長期耐久性相同。~Equal28-day strength implies identical long-term durability.
units.practice: 在「收縮、耐久性與時間尺度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0006 strain，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未控制溫濕度會把環境差異誤當材料效應。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for shrinkage, durability and time scale, first reproduce 0.0006 strain, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Uncontrolled temperature/humidity confounds material effects." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 批次放行與持續品管~Lot release and ongoing quality control
units.mechanism: 來源、級配、含水、污染及試拌結果需串接；品質改變時重新評估配比而非沿用舊值。~Link provenance, gradation, moisture, contamination and trials; reassess mixtures when quality changes rather than reusing old values.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：absorption shift=new-old;0.075-0.06；計算 0.075-0.06 = 0.015 fraction points。適用限制：假想批次吸水率改變1.5個百分點。~Original hypothetical teaching example: absorption shift=new-old;0.075-0.06; calculation 0.075-0.06 = 0.015 fraction points. Applicability: Hypothetical lot absorption change of1.5percentage points.
units.verify: 用新吸水率重算水修正並觸發一次試拌檢查。~Recalculate water correction with new absorption and trigger a trial-mix check.
units.failure: 舊含水修正套用新料批會讓有效水量逐批漂移。~Old moisture corrections on new lots create drifting effective water.
units.misconception: 首次試拌合格後就不需要再檢查骨材批次。~After one successful trial mix, later aggregate lots need no checks.
units.practice: 在「批次放行與持續品管」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.015 fraction points，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「舊含水修正套用新料批會讓有效水量逐批漂移。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for lot release and ongoing quality control, first reproduce 0.015 fraction points, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Old moisture corrections on new lots create drifting effective water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
